tagline: The card. The number. The miss.

NFL: A backup safety on the injury report is not a reason to smash the other quarterback.
In a total under 45, take the dog and the running backs before you captain the quarterback.
49ers +3.5 cashed 27-7 in Melbourne. A travel-week favorite is fadeable when the dog can run.
CFB: Fire 6-to-10 point ranked sides in real conference games. Alabama and BYU cashed.
Ohio State +1.5 cashed 24-23 after Texas erased 20. A late-lead dog still has a number.
Tennessee -11.5 cashed 45-24 on the road. Ranked 10-12 point sides in real games stay live.
MLB: Confirm the lineup at first pitch. A bat that does not play is a void.
Soto HR and Cole o2.5 ER cashed while Yankees ML died 12-2. Split the bat from the chalk ML.

NFL: Do not captain a short-week home favorite just because the name is bigger.
Patriots +3 pushed SEA 13-10. A 3-point short-week opener is a number, not a smash.
CFB: Road 20-plus after a one-score opener is not a lay. Oregon lost 39-31 at Oklahoma State.
A 50-plus number can win the game and miss the spread. Indiana 55-0 missed -57.5.
Iowa 16-13 missed -14. Rivalry dogs keep ranked home favorites inside a touchdown.
MLB: Do not lay home juice worse than -200.
Do not glue Friday's final onto Saturday's rematch. Yankees cashed Friday and lost 12-2 Saturday.
